games.title: Unpinning
games.blurb: Pin a loop of rope so that pulling it tight cannot untangle it.
games.theorem: Simon & Stucky, the pinning ideal of a multiloop (arXiv:2405.16216)

games.title: Untangling
games.blurb: Collapse the lenses out of a tangled loop, in as few moves as you can. A lens is a space the curve closes off with just two crossings.
